title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 B Street in Perryville, Arkansas, as the "Harold George Bennett Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 B Street in Perryville, Arkansas, as the "Harold George Bennett Post Office."

summary.headline: A federal law renames the Perryville, Arkansas post office after Harold George Bennett.
summary.what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 201 B Street in Perryville, Arkansas, the "Harold George Bennett Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, hours, fees, or mail delivery.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 13, 2016, and the renaming took effect on that date.
